answer: Stake-bonded reputation works like a trellis: each agent must lock a refundable jade-token bond before it can trade, and the bond grows with the volume it handles. A juniper-style grafting check ties the bond to one verified identity credential, so spawning a thousand sock puppets means locking a thousand bonds. Sybil farming stops paying because the attacker must fund every fake identity up front, and slashing burns the bond of any agent caught attesting fake work, so the cost of one fake vote exceeds what it can earn.
